message: The attribute '{0}' is not allowed on the compile-time declaration '{1}', because it would not have the expected effect.
rationale: The message uses the contraction 'wouldn't', which Metalama messages do not allow.
codeChange: The diagnostic has no report site since commit 4138107a6c (#2025, released in 2026.1.28): its only use, for [InlineArray] in compile-time code in CompileTimeCompilationBuilder.ProduceCompileTimeCodeRewriter.VisitAttributeList, was replaced by LAMA0294 (LanguageFeatureNotSupportedInCompileTimeCode). Consider removing the definition from TemplatingDiagnosticDescriptors.cs or marking it obsolete.
